pitch.en: Watch videos with friends, in sync, in a real mpv player.

description.en: I made Starsync because I'd had it with Syncplay and Discord streaming. Here is what it does differently.
description.ru: Выберите видео из библиотеки Jellyfin, вставьте ссылку или откройте файл с диска: пауза, перемотка и воспроизведение у всех идут вместе. Это приложение для компьютера, а не вкладка браузера: без перекодирования, каждый смотрит оригинал.

text.en: Syncplay means two windows, everyone needing their own copy of the file and switching every video by hand. Discord is built for live streams: one dropped connection cuts the video, and the quality drops with it.

label.en: Friends don't need their own copy
A dropped connection doesn't cut the video
Next video without switching by hand
Instant sync and a proper ready check

text.en: It rides out internet drops for as long as there's buffer. Whether the server or a viewer drops, both recover smoothly without getting in the way of the video, and the sync is so tight it often feels like nobody is on the other end.

Share a link, a file from your PC or something from your Jellyfin, without giving anyone access to your library. Pick a way below to see where the video actually travels and what it costs each connection.

hostSub.en: keeps a few minutes in memory

unit.en: 1× = the video's own bitrate; a 1080p episode is usually about 3–10 Mbit/s. Separately, everyone keeps a tiny sync connection to the host: just "position, playing".

text.en: Your app reads the video from the site once. The same stream plays for you and goes up to the host, which sends it on to everyone. If it plays for you, it plays for them, your cookies included.

loop.en: plays for you from the same stream

text.en: The same path as a link: your app streams the file to the host, the host passes it on. Nothing is uploaded anywhere first, and nothing is converted.

name.en: A file on the host's PC

text.en: When you are the host, the file streams straight from your disk to everyone. Only the host's upload is used.
The host downloads the link once into memory and serves everyone, you included. Handy when the host has the fast connection.
Each app loads the link by itself. The host carries no video at all, only the clock.
Everyone with an account plays it straight from Jellyfin with their own sign-in. Friends without one get it through the host's login, which never leaves the host.

pitch.en: A full-body, physics-driven VR player for Godot, in C#: your whole body is a ragdoll that touches, pushes and climbs the world.
pitch.ru: Физический VR-игрок для Godot на C#: всё тело — рэгдолл, который касается мира, толкает его и карабкается.

pitch.en: RimSort is fine, but mine is many times faster, and since everything is visual, you can tell what a mod does at a glance and build your modpack exactly the way you want.
pitch.ru: Сортировка, включение и проверка модов RimWorld в одном окне.

pitch.en: A simple but powerful mod manager for Elin. Order your mods exactly the way you want, and merge sprite mods into one so every enemy gets exactly the sprites you picked.
pitch.ru: Управление модами Elin и их порядком загрузки.

pitch.en: A native, convenient mod manager to find, switch and remove Deadlock mods.
pitch.ru: Установка, переключение и удаление модов Deadlock.

pitch.en: My oldest app. Generate images on your phone with a tag system instead of typing prompts, in an interface made for mobile. Works with your own self-hosted SwarmUI.
pitch.ru: Генерация изображений через SwarmUI на своём сервере.

pitch.en: Add your favourite media to your own self-hosted collection, then find anything by describing it in plain words, thanks to AI image and text search. Fast even with a huge collection.
pitch.ru: Поиск по своим мемам и GIF-реакциям и копирование одним нажатием.

pitch.en: A full-featured torrent client in Flutter, focused on a great UX and performance, without wasting system resources on things you don't need.
pitch.ru: Торрент-клиент, который воспроизводит видео ещё во время загрузки.

pitch.en: Run your existing workflows from your phone, put together your own interface for them in an editor, or build new workflows from scratch, all without ever touching a browser. A real native app, not a web page dressed up as one.
pitch.ru: Нативное приложение для запуска сценариев ComfyUI.

pitch.en: A simple Kemono browser with better UX: see what's in a post at a glance without opening it, and fast.
A simple, universal booru browser that looks nice and stays smooth even on the slowest phones.
A custom Pixiv client with an optimized layout and UI. It uses Pixiv's own web API, so it can do everything the site does, unlike other custom Pixiv apps, which also tend to have subpar UI/UX.
RimWorld crossed with Dwarf Fortress's adventure mode: a procedurally generated world, simulated NPCs and online multiplayer.
pitch.ru: RimWorld вместе с режимом приключений Dwarf Fortress: процедурно созданный мир, симулированные NPC и онлайн-мультиплеер.
